summary: Align the version-19 hotfix Cargo and flake PTY pins at 4b823084

schema.detail: Storage remains version 19; no database schema change.

compatibility.detail: PTY advances from f8388fe7 to 4b823084: event-log writes batch within 250 ms (#137), terminal subscribers disconnect on close (#159), explicit restart waits for predecessor exit (#160), and managed publication gains durable revocation (#158). The c5e19e6f follow-up includes batching fixes, follower delivery from start, process-group kill through a reap fence, daemon input on its own thread, and removal of cursor_visible from persisted events plus temporary-file garbage collection (#172); there is no on-disk protocol change. No Smalltalk caller starts passing publication flags. Unenrolled roots retain JSONL and metadata format compatibility; downgrade requires per-host, per-root absence checks for .publication-revocations and .publication-revocations/v1/root.json. If publication state exists, use a forward fix only; never remove it to permit downgrade.

downtime.detail: No forced restarts; sessions use the selected binary on natural restart.

manual.detail: Do not enroll publication roots until rollout is verified on all target hosts. This dependency-only hotfix does not activate services or modify storage.

recovery.detail: No Smalltalk recovery change. ST_SKIP_EVIDENCE=1 is used for this branch-only push; hosted CI remains the exact-commit release proof.
